note: Read 2026-10-31 in archive.org's snapshot of 26 September 2026 of the Department of Motor Traffic's own page 'New Driving License' (dmt.gov.lk gives this egress no answer). For a new licence for light vehicles: the written test from 17, a learner's permit of up to 18 months, and 'One should complete 18 years of age to face the practical test', at least three months after the permit. The fee and the term are null: the Department's 'Charges For Services' page has no archived copy, and its renewal page (snapshot of 10 July 2026, read) gives no term; the 2022 levy gazette's renewal levy is a renewal's fee and wasn't used.
